text: Technological transformation stalls until its supporting infrastructure exists: the digital transformation was inhibited until infrastructure was built, laws were updated, and new institutions were created, just as the steam and combustion engines required new streets, wiring, laws, and institutions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859

isBasedOn.name: Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades
